narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three eights and one left over. I write one, then three.
<bookmark mark='place'/>The eights place sits on the left, like our tens place.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Written that way, it means one eight and three ones, which is only eleven.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows the digits 1 then 3; the places 8s and 1s light up; 1 × 8 + 3 = 11 appears; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, multiply each digit by the value of its place and add.
<bookmark mark='back'/>Every one of the three numerals should come back to twenty five.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; check lines: 3 × 8 + 1 = 25; 1 × 25 = 25; 16 + 8 + 1 = 25

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu finds three eights and one left over, then writes one, then three. The eights place sits on the left like our tens place, so the three comes first.
